purpose: Teach: 追記/新装/賞与/取り調べ/動員/次期/顕著/買い付け

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察規則に、本気で、絶対、追記、絶対、改正、絶対、ご対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're working steadily to implement the policy amendments in full accordance with police regulations.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Professional but not stiff. Slight pause before each key phrase, letting the weight settle. No rush. The confidence of someone who knows the protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察署の、本気で、絶対、新装、絶対、警察様、絶対、お祝い、絶対、申し上げます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're honored to support the police station's renovation and wish to extend our congratulations.
lines.style: Formal agreement. Respectful but genuine—not merely reciting lines. Slight emphasis on 'honored.' Steady eye contact level. Warm beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察官への、本気で、絶対、賞与、絶対、ご対応、絶対、進められております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're also committed to handling the compensation arrangements for our officers in coordination with your department.
lines.style: Clear, procedural tone. Speaking with quiet authority about logistics. Each clause lands with equal weight. No apology, no excess—just facts delivered with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、取り調べ、絶対、ご協力、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the opportunity to cooperate with you on this investigation.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm, genuine gratitude underneath the formal phrasing. Not rushing—letting the sincerity breathe. A slight smile audible.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、人員、絶対、動員、絶対、警備、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're strengthening our force deployment and security operations to support the department's ongoing work.
lines.style: Deliberate, assured. Speaking about concrete action. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening'—showing commitment. Calm authority. The tone of someone executing a plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次期、本気で、絶対、警察署長、絶対、ご就任、絶対、お祝いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'd like to extend our sincere congratulations to the incoming police chief on his appointment.
lines.style: Formal warmth. Speaking with ceremony but without stiffness. Gentle emphasis on 'sincere congratulations.' The tone of someone offering genuine well-wishes at an occasion.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、顕著、絶対、な、絶対、犯罪減少、絶対、皆様のご協力、絶対、おかげです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The marked decrease in crime in this area is a testament to everyone's cooperation and dedication.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Speaking with quiet pride in a shared accomplishment. Slight pause before 'everyone's cooperation'—letting it land. Grounded, not effusive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の、本気で、絶対、装備の、絶対、買い付け、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to supporting the police department's equipment procurement needs going forward.
lines.style: Professional commitment. Speaking with quiet conviction about tangible support. No flourish—just a clear statement of partnership. Steady, reliable tone.
